inputs.name: ticks

inputs.name: action

inputs.name: seed

actions.description: Set the seed used by the simulated world's random number generators for subsequent steps, without resetting the world. The accepted seed is echoed in the receipt.

facts.text: The action space is Box(low=-1, high=1, shape=(3,), dtype=float32)
A step scales the action by max_action_mm_deg and applies it with _sim_step
step returns (observation, reward, terminated, truncated, info)
reset accepts offset_mm_deg, seed, peg_idx and options and returns (observation, info)
The separate seed(seed) method calls numpy.random.seed
The default observation holds relative_motion of four floats and gt_offset of three floats
The marker-flow subclass replaces surface_pts with marker_flow of shape (2, 2, 128, 2) and rebuilds observation_space from that default observation
get_obs drops surface_pts and adds marker_flow from the two tactile sensors
When render_rgb is true the observation also carries rgb_images shaped (2, 240, 320, 3)
The tactile movement flag is set when the mean surface difference exceeds 1.5e-3 m
The error flag is set when the x or y offset exceeds 12 mm or the theta offset exceeds 15 degrees
Success requires no error, no step limit, no tactile movement flag, steps times z_step_size_mm above 0.35, and every peg bottom point more than 0.3 mm below the hole surface
The episode truncates when too_many_steps, tactile_movement_too_large or error_too_large is set
The reward subtracts step_penalty, adds final_reward on success and adds a remaining-steps penalty when the episode is truncated by error or tactile movement

determinism.notes: the fake's reset draws the initial offset with Python's random.Random(seed) and the offsets then evolve deterministically, so one fake repeats a trajectory for the same seed and actions; the upstream reset accepts seed but never uses it (its randomness is numpy's global stream, seeded by the separate seed() method), so the two do not share a trajectory for a seed

gaps: the fake is a kinematic stand-in, not the upstream SAPIEN/IPC simulator: it adds the commanded x, y and theta offsets and a fixed insertion step directly, with no rigid-body contacts, no FEM/IPC tactile deformation, no actuator, sensor or noise model and no rendering (F0: no dynamics)
one tick advances one insertion step and no simulated time is advanced (timestep_ms 0); there is no wall-clock pacing
the marker_flow observation is (2, 2, 128, 2) in the upstream space but the fake returns zeros; the real optical marker flow of the two tactile sensors is not modelled

the fake honours reset(seed=...) for reproducibility, while upstream reset accepts seed and does not use it and upstream randomness is numpy's global generator; equal seeds therefore do not give equal trajectories between the fake and the upstream environment
the optional rgb_images observation (2, 240, 320, 3) of render_rgb=True is not rendered by the fake
the bridge is configured with autoreset=True: a step after a terminal or truncated state starts a new full episode, whereas the upstream Gymnasium environment requires the caller to reset it
the upstream environment requires SAPIEN, sapienipc and CUDA and was never imported, run or compared with this fake; no physical device is modelled and nothing was validated
snapshot and restore are not offered: the upstream class exposes no get_state/set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: an e-stop makes the runtime refuse step and reset until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state stays readable and no hardware is moved
